title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
key_facts: Hark founded less than a year ago by serial founder Brett Adcock
Wide release of Hark Pro on 6 Oct 2026
Free access with a subscription tier for heavy users
Built on a model trained specifically for computer use
Shows the agent navigating the web in a small window to build trust
Users connect email, calendar, hard drive, credit cards
Company says it will not sell ads or data
quote_evidence: Hark, a startup founded less than a year ago by serial founder Brett Adcock, is throwing its hat in the ring today with the wide release of Hark Pro.
The foundation is a model trained specifically for computer use, and that’s what Hark Pro does — it uses your computer for you.
Hark promises to release an AI-native device to support its software in 2027.
why_it_matters_hint: A new assistant that does tasks end to end on a user's computer, with open questions on privacy and model breadth.
notes: Follow-up of the 6 Oct pool item "Figure plans to release Hark AI assistant this week". The TechCrunch text does not mention Figure, so the link between Figure and Hark rests on yesterday's headline only.
